coverage_policy.evidence_rule: Test references are source-linked candidates only; no status implies scenario qualification without a separate exact-head execution receipt.

known_gaps: No concrete multi-agent direct-call test reference has been verified for each target integrity/authorization boundary.
Requires unrelated-agent negative controls and before/after protected-state digests across identity, finance, commons and governance.
No pinned-runtime, at-least-three-agent visibility test has been verified for this scenario.
Requires separate authoring, peer-validation and peer-visibility timestamps and an injected bounded timeout.
No exact test reference proving one logical effect across retries has been verified.
Requires operation-ID binding, retry/response-loss injection, durable receipt comparison and state-digest evidence.
No exact test reference proving same idempotency key with different payload is rejected has been verified.
Requires a stable payload digest and a negative control that mutates intent while preserving the operation key.
No pinned-runtime race test proving finalized allocations never exceed capacity has been verified.
Requires concurrent independent agents, contention levels, and an explicit documented allocation/serialization protocol.
No end-to-end concurrent-writer test with an explicit, independently observed conflict policy has been verified.
Requires two independent writers, deterministic interleaving, accepted-version inventory and current-projection digest.
No concrete integrity-zome action corpus mapped to this scenario has been verified.
Requires direct invalid-op fixtures and peer-visible negative controls for a named zome.

test_references.purpose: Distinguishes a successful empty source read from a live read with records.
Checks a failed refresh preserves last-success freshness instead of implying current data.
Checks a first-read failure is unavailable, not a confirmed empty result.
Checks UI copy distinguishes confirmed-empty from unavailable.
Checks demo/conflicting evidence copy does not imply live confirmation.
Checks unsupported integration is not rendered as confirmed empty.

known_gaps: These unit tests cover selected Personal source-state transitions and user-facing distinctions, not every adapter or every state transition in every domain.
No multi-agent or provider-fault-injection test has been verified for unavailable, stale, conflicting or unsupported real source adapters.
No independent execution receipt currently maps this scenario to a fully passing benchmark run.

test_references.purpose: Checks a failed refresh after a previous success transitions that source to Stale with its last successful read time.
Checks no prior success is represented as Unavailable rather than current/empty.
Checks UI text does not make an unavailable source appear empty.

known_gaps: The mapped tests do not cover expiry/revocation or every domain's source revision policy.
No injected clock matrix or multi-agent source-revision change has been verified.
No execution receipt has qualified the complete scenario.
Issue #5240 tracks the current Health Vault consent lifecycle gaps; no verified multi-agent revocation/expiry authorization test is mapped here.
Requires source-side authorization checks for expired and revoked grants, stale status and disconnected consumers, not only UI filtering.
The Life Continuity disclosure rehearsal is synthetic/local-only and is not an authorization-enforcement test.
Requires a protected data fixture, authenticated consumer, field-level allowlist, negative disclosure sentinels and recipient-side observation.
No pinned trusted-key verifier vector suite has been mapped to this scenario.
Requires trusted and untrusted signing keys, revoked/unknown key states, and stable rejection-reason receipts.
No context-transplant negative-control suite has been mapped to this scenario.
Requires mutating request, profile revision, actor, purpose, scope and operation-binding fields one at a time.
No status-endpoint outage/freshness matrix with a controlled clock is mapped to this scenario.
Requires status unknown/expired/revoked/unavailable cases and explicit policy for prior cached status.
No crash-after-commit/before-response test with state reconciliation has been mapped.
Requires process termination at controlled commit boundaries and retry verification of logical effect count.
No partition/rejoin test with explicit pending and conflict state has been mapped.
Requires fixed fault schedules, local/peer state digests and eventual reconciliation observations.
No committed/pending/failed operation restart test has been mapped for the pinned runtime.
Requires a fresh process/conductor restart, durable receipt checks and documented persistence assumptions.
No authenticated cross-zome authority-boundary test has been mapped to this scenario.
Requires the actual authenticated caller to be authoritative, with payload actor substitution and unauthorized target-scope controls.
No versioned acceptance/rejection vector suite across supported verifier/schema versions has been mapped.
Requires explicit unsupported and downgrade fixtures with a loss-detection assertion.
